name: PUKA

laws: One game state, multiple presentation routes
Presentation organs may read visible state but must not infer expose or duplicate hidden game state
Physical visualisation of chips may represent values already shown to the player but must not create a second bankroll authority
Card-reveal presentation may respond to already-visible cards but must not predict or inspect undealt cards
Royal progression must become visible in the world rather than existing only as text
Portrait Academy may personify cards; Royal Table remains ceremonial and more realistic
Premium composition must improve focal clarity rather than merely add ornament
Both presentation routes deserve authored environments rather than primary and fallback status
Phone portrait routes to Portrait Academy; phone landscape routes to Royal Table
Visual quality is a completion gate, not decoration after completion
Different games may share organs without sharing identities
One singular live direct door is the normal owner contact route
No real-money wagering in this stage body
claimBoundary: Living-table source stage. Automated source/core/layout/art/world/material/theatre/living-table tests and public contact may Ding independently; owner-side visual-quality acceptance and Cold Ding remain separate.
